slides.headline: does the *full moon* make people act crazy? the *dec 23* fact-check
“everyone acts unhinged on a full moon”
slides.body: large reviews of hospital, emergency and police records mostly find no reliable link to wild behaviour. some small studies suggest people sleep a bit less. tired is not unhinged.

slides.headline: a full moon is just the *moon* opposite the sun
slides.body: earth sits between them, so we see the whole lit side, about every 29.5 days. it isn't closer or stronger, just brighter, and bright nights stick.

slides.headline: astrologers read full moons as *culminations*
slides.body: a peak, not a breakdown: what started at the new moon comes to a head. the dec 23 full moon is in cancer: home, family, who you miss.

slides.headline: nobody is *crazy*. some people are just finally honest
slides.body: say the honest thing. blame the moon if you need to.
